title: Empowering solar-driven degradation: advancements in lanthanum-doped Bi2O3/g-C3N4 heterojunctions for high-performance photocatalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17555-17569
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01451H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
M. M. Rashed, Mohamed Abdel Rafea, Mohamed I. Attia, Mohamed R. El-Aassar, Tasneem I. Hussein, Salma Saddeek, Imran Shakir, Mazen R. Alrahili, Muhammad Aadil
A La-doped Bi2O3/g-C3N4 heterojunction photocatalyst was synthesized, showing enhanced visible light absorption and charge separation, achieving excellent degradation of methylene blue (97%) and ciprofloxacin (84%).
